_about: Onboarding cutscenes. Art by Eko/Pulse (art/pda-v1/imports/onboarding, originals in source/). 'text' transcribes what each frame shows, for screen readers and for reduced-motion players; 'flash' marks glitch frames that reduced motion skips. ms is how long a beat holds when it plays on its own. Plays once per browser; City ID can replay the registration.

beats.text: New Halo, a Crownline initiative. Adyta Civic Registry: identity registration. Initializing secure session…
Registration complete. Identity verified. Civic status: Resident. Network access: granted.
“You spent that time building someone interesting…”
“…just to hand them over to a filing cabinet? Nah.”
Welcome to the other Adyta. Your city. Your story. Your signal.

radio.label: Radio Sewers: hide it
radio.text: Radio Sewers is patched in. If a street sweep or an ID check comes, hit Hide it: the PDA flips to your City ID, and the station was never here.
